title: Pick the WMBT direction verb from the controlled palette

facts.note: Planner authors or edits a WMBT.
WMBT artifacts are identifiable by path/file kind.
Task text mentions WMBTs or optimization direction.

values: wmbt direction verb added or changed
facts.note: Needs a WMBT diff/parser observer that extracts the direction field/verb.
Palette membership is mechanical, but only once the direction-field extraction observer exists.
Whether the verb's sense matches the WMBT goal needs semantic judgement.

fires: Planner writes a new WMBT and must state its optimization direction.
Planner edits an existing WMBT's direction or goal wording.
A WMBT uses a free-form verb (e.g. a synonym) instead of a canonical direction.
doesNotFire: Editing acceptances, wagons or docs without touching any WMBT direction.
Coder-side implementation changes that do not author WMBTs.

given: A WMBT is being authored or edited and needs an optimization direction.
when: The planner chooses the direction verb for the WMBT.
then: Select the optimization direction verb that matches the WMBT's goal from the controlled palette (minimize, maximize, increase, decrease).
prefer: Use the palette (canonical direction -> synonyms) to map goal wording: minimize ← reduce, decrease, lower, shrink; maximize ← increase, boost, raise, grow; increase ← improve, elevate, accelerate; decrease ← cut, dampen, slow, limit.
Write a canonical direction (a palette key) rather than a synonym.

Note: 'increase' and 'decrease' are listed both as canonical keys and as synonyms (of maximize and minimize respectively); the palette does not say which reading wins, so both are palette-conformant—pick the one whose sense matches the goal and do not claim the palette settles it.
avoid: Inventing a direction verb outside the palette.
Writing a non-key synonym in place of a canonical direction.
Choosing a direction whose sense contradicts the goal (e.g. minimize for something the goal wants to grow).
why: The palette is a controlled vocabulary mapping each canonical direction to its synonyms; choosing from it keeps the direction verb within that vocabulary and matched to the goal.
evidence: Each WMBT carries exactly one direction value that is a canonical palette key.
Reviewer confirms the direction's sense matches the WMBT goal.
verifier_detail: Direction palette (term_id: direction, label: 'Direction palette'): canonical direction -> synonyms.

Observation only: 'decrease' occurs both as a canonical key and as a minimize synonym; 'increase' occurs both as a canonical key and as a maximize synonym. The source does not define how this overlap is resolved.
